title: The Image of Dysfunction or the Image of God Which One Are You?
body:
IUIC in the ClassRoom · 2026-09-27

Opens [Isa 34](/bible/isaiah/34) · [Dan 7](/bible/daniel/7) · [Isa 54](/bible/isaiah/54) · [2 Esdras 7](/bible/2-esdras/7) · [Jer 1](/bible/jeremiah/1) · [Judith 5](/bible/judith/5) · [Isa 62](/bible/isaiah/62) · [Ps 91](/bible/psalms/91)
## Introduction *[[11:04](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lTjnCZsWsng&t=664s)]* A Sabbath class from Bishop Yawasap on the eve of the new moon: The Image of Dysfunction or the Image of God, which one are you? It opens by anchoring everything in the book of the Lord, the everlasting kingdom of Daniel 7, and Romans 9 on God raising up Esau to be destroyed, then reads 2 Esdras 7 on the narrow entrance to the kingdom and Judges 3 on the nations left to teach Israel war. The heart of the class works through Captain Gedaliah's book When Trauma Speaks: were you created or conditioned? You were made in the image of God, known before the womb, and the composite of slavery, trauma, and self-doubt is not the real you. The Bishop traces the conditioning to the enemy's secret councils, the seasoning of slaves, the fourth-grade failure syndrome, frolic as a betraying comfort, and painkillers that never treat the cause, and closes with where to start: shut down the wicked holidays as a nation and keep God's feast days. ## In The News - *[[19:30](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lTjnCZsWsng&t=1170s)]* **An image of the Ancient of Days with hair like pure wool.** — If God sat, had a garment, and had hair like wool, he has a body, and it is not the Caucasian painted in the churches. Black people. How you like me now? - *[[45:51](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lTjnCZsWsng&t=2751s)]* **The class trailer: Hosea warned that Israel would abide many days without an image; stripped of identity, now accepting a counterfeit; fornication or marriage, drunkenness or sobriety, mercy or murder, coons or kings, one man or the army of God; the image of dysfunction or the image of God.** — Shout out to the media team. That is the question for every one of us, as individuals and as a nation. - *[[1:06:20](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lTjnCZsWsng&t=3980s)]* **Captain Gedaliah's book When Trauma Speaks, chapter 10, Created versus Conditioned, pages 112 and 113.** — Every person must confront a foundational question: am I who I was created to be or who I was conditioned to become? Everything in you was shaped by one of two forces, creation or conditioning; one is intentional and reflects origin, the other is reactive and reflects adaptation to slavery, ghettos, and abuse. Most live in between without distinguishing them. Our job is to distinguish what we were made into from who we truly are. - *[[1:15:47](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lTjnCZsWsng&t=4547s)]* **A picture of a man holding a sign in front of his face.** — The conditioned self is the sign we show the world; the real soul is hidden behind it and scared. When the Bishop talks to our people he is usually talking to the mask, the representative, not the real them. The real you has not surfaced yet and must be encouraged to come forward. - *[[1:40:48](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lTjnCZsWsng&t=6048s)]* **Richard Williams's book They Stole It, But You Must Return It, chapter 4, What did white America do to the black father?** — Blacks came from a country where many men were warriors and family heads, and those men were a threat to white America's economic plans, so the submission of the black male became the major emphasis of a slave system built to destroy his manhood. Nobody sails across an ocean for dummies; they brought brilliant people to build this place and had to make them dysfunctional. The fourth-grade failure syndrome in Countering the Conspiracy to Destroy Black Boys is the same work: teachers spot genius in your sons and kill it, as they killed Malcolm's aspiration to be a lawyer. That is why Jacob's Hope Academy matters. - *[[1:48:00](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lTjnCZsWsng&t=6480s)]* **From Babylon to Timbuktu by Rudolph Windsor on the black Jews of the Ghanaian states: kings, princes, governors, generals, secretaries, treasurers, judges, architects, engineers, doctors, historians, interpreters, mathematicians, jewellers, masons, goldsmiths, blacksmiths, agriculturalists.** — We carried our laws and written records with us and absorbed the native tribes. Esau said we need that industry and skill over here. Dummies do not build societies; the enslaved mind of a resourceful people did, and Black Wall Street, Durham, and Rosewood showed what we built with nothing, so they bombed it. - *[[2:01:33](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lTjnCZsWsng&t=7293s)]* **Dictionary slides for the squeaky wheel gets the oil: the one who complains loudest gets attention, help, or results; quiet people are ignored.** — They want us on mute, with community guidelines blocking the word of God while a man with a chicken goes unflagged. We will squeak: prophesy, complain, bring out the records, and bug the Most High until he kills our enemies. That is why they clamped down on conscious rap, Public Enemy, KRS-One, Lakim Shabazz, Professor Griff, and pushed gangster rap. Thank God for Original Royalty. - *[[2:09:07](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lTjnCZsWsng&t=7747s)]* **An old flyer, Who are the blacks that were brought to America on slave ships, citing Deuteronomy 28:15, Ezekiel 39:23, and Luke 21:24.** — Bishop Nathanyel made these from a book of artwork he had. He never handed out a crinkled flyer, because the flyer represents your faith. That discipline is why IUIC flyers look the way they do now. - *[[2:11:20](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lTjnCZsWsng&t=7880s)]* **A commentator: keep him in destructive mode, do not let him think about anything serious, because then he becomes a danger; produce an image of comfort, which is false.** — That is exactly why we are pushed toward sports, entertainment, and dancing. Frolic means to play about in a carefree way. The white mother buys her son a model plane to build over days; the black family buys it assembled, from the book Black Men by Haki Madhubuti. One family raises rulers, the other raises consumers. - *[[2:19:29](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lTjnCZsWsng&t=8369s)]* **Lest We Forget by Velma Maia Thomas, the passage on seasoning: the process that broke strong men and women, stripped them of dignity, rewarded good behaviour and punished bad, and remade men into an image pleasing to their oppressor; the wise slave master never believed his captives were natural-born slaves and knew their psychology had to be altered.** — Seasoning is what they still do to our sports figures, entertainers, and politicians. It remade us from the image of God into the image of dysfunction, the Negro made in a laboratory. The real man inside wants to be free and squeaks all day, but some men are too cowardly to let him speak. - *[[2:22:45](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lTjnCZsWsng&t=8565s)]* **A viral video of a man dancing on a table for white executives, trying to get a record deal.** — On the slave ships they made us dance so we looked healthy at market and so we looked happy. If we look happy they can present us as well treated. That is a betraying comfort, and it teaches a young son that this is what to aspire to. - *[[2:27:46](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lTjnCZsWsng&t=8866s)]* **An old clip of the Bishop in a New York YouTube studio with Officer Jonah, from the series The Truth Shall Make You Free, titled Painkillers: Christianity, like a painkiller, kills the pain for a moment but never treats the cause, so the homes stay broken and the men keep going to jail.** — Drugs, alcohol, sitcoms, cell phones, and social media are painkillers too, a kaleidoscope of foolishness that never asks who we really are. You have to go to the source of the pain and the real image of yourself to fix it; the church just gets high on the drums and the Hammond organ. - *[[2:31:46](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lTjnCZsWsng&t=9106s)]* **An Israeli government official on American soil naming black Americans as the problem.** — The secret councils are not jive. They were literally talking about us, and they know the prophecy. - *[[2:33:23](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lTjnCZsWsng&t=9203s)]* **A documentary from Tacoma, Washington: Kimani Carter, sentenced at eighteen to life for a 1997 gang drive-by that killed Corey Pittman, an innocent college student, describes his first mission as a kid, the adrenaline, being scared but not scared because backing out makes you a punk, and the man who would rather be an important tyrant than an average citizen.** — This is by design: kids with no father and no hope, cut off from everything, driven into crime and locked away. Only in prison did he understand that a life taken can never be replaced. ## Scriptures Opened **[Isaiah 34:16-17](/bible/isaiah/34#v16)** *[[12:03](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lTjnCZsWsng&t=723s)]* > [16](/bible/isaiah/34#v16) Seek ye out of the book of the Lord, and read: no one of these shall fail, none shall want her mate: for my mouth it hath commanded, and his spirit it hath gathered them. > > [17](/bible/isaiah/34#v17) And he hath cast the lot for them, and his hand hath divided it unto them by line: they shall possess it for ever, from generation to generation shall they dwell therein. - Seek ye out of the book of the Lord, and read. In these trying times, in the world, the nation, our families, and our sanctuaries, the Bible is the compass; without it we are completely lost. The book of the Lord is no other book on this planet. - No one of these shall fail; every prophecy in this Bible will come to pass, not one jot or tittle failing. None shall want her mate: you cannot mate the Bible with another book or add to it, as Revelation and Proverbs warn. God's mouth commanded the books and his spirit gathered them; he cast the lot and divided it by line, five books to Moses and so on. - They shall possess it for ever, from generation to generation. Through every captivity the Most High made sure the Bible followed us; the Greeks tried to destroy it and he raised Ezra to bring it back. The Bible did not go anywhere; your mind went into dysfunction and left it. Precepts: - **[Ecclesiastes 12:12-13](/bible/ecclesiastes/12#v12)** > [12](/bible/ecclesiastes/12#v12) And further, by these, my son, be admonished: of making many books there is no end; and much study is a weariness of the flesh. > > [13](/bible/ecclesiastes/12#v13) Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter: Fear God, and keep his commandments: for this is the whole duty of man. Of making many books there is no end, and much study is a weariness of the flesh. Any book you try to live by outside the Bible profits you nothing but tiredness, unless a demon flies out of it. Books are brought in class only filtered through the Bible, to give the sense as in Nehemiah 8:8; if a book contradicts it, it is garbage. The conclusion of the whole matter: fear God and keep his commandments, found only in the Bible, for this is the whole duty of man. The image of God is doing what God said. - **[Nehemiah 8:8](/bible/nehemiah/8#v8)** > [8](/bible/nehemiah/8#v8) So they read in the book in the law of God distinctly, and gave the sense, and caused them to understand the reading. They read in the book of the law distinctly, gave the sense, and caused them to understand the reading. That is why tangible references are used: to illuminate what is written. **[Daniel 7:9-28](/bible/daniel/7#v9)** *[[17:07](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lTjnCZsWsng&t=1027s)]* > [9](/bible/daniel/7#v9) I beheld till the thrones were cast down, and the Ancient of days did sit, whose garment was white as snow, and the hair of his head like the pure wool: his throne was like the fiery flame, and his wheels as burning fire. > > [10](/bible/daniel/7#v10) A fiery stream issued and came forth from before him: thousand thousands ministered unto him, and ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him: the judgment was set, and the books were opened. > > [11](/bible/daniel/7#v11) I beheld then because of the voice of the great words which the horn spake: I beheld even till the beast was slain, and his body destroyed, and given to the burning flame. > > [12](/bible/daniel/7#v12) As concerning the rest of the beasts, they had their dominion taken away: yet their lives were prolonged for a season and time. > > [13](/bible/daniel/7#v13) I saw in the night visions, and, behold, one like the Son of man came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the Ancient of days, and they brought him near before him. > > [14](/bible/daniel/7#v14) And there was given him dominion, and glory, and a kingdom, that all people, nations, and languages, should serve him: his dominion is an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away, and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed. > > [15](/bible/daniel/7#v15) I Daniel was grieved in my spirit in the midst of my body, and the visions of my head troubled me. > > [16](/bible/daniel/7#v16) I came near unto one of them that stood by, and asked him the truth of all this. So he told me, and made me know the interpretation of the things. > > [17](/bible/daniel/7#v17) These great beasts, which are four, are four kings, which shall arise out of the earth. > > [18](/bible/daniel/7#v18) But the saints of the most High shall take the kingdom, and possess the kingdom for ever, even for ever and ever. > > [19](/bible/daniel/7#v19) Then I would know the truth of the fourth beast, which was diverse from all the others, exceeding dreadful, whose teeth were of iron, and his nails of brass; which devoured, brake in pieces, and stamped the residue with his feet; > > [20](/bible/daniel/7#v20) And of the ten horns that were in his head, and of the other which came up, and before whom three fell; even of that horn that had eyes, and a mouth that spake very great things, whose look was more stout than his fellows. > > [21](/bible/daniel/7#v21) I beheld, and the same horn made war with the saints, and prevailed against them; > > [22](/bible/daniel/7#v22) Until the Ancient of days came, and judgment was given to the saints of the most High; and the time came that the saints possessed the kingdom. > > [23](/bible/daniel/7#v23) Thus he said, The fourth beast shall be the fourth kingdom upon earth, which shall be diverse from all kingdoms, and shall devour the whole earth, and shall tread it down, and break it in pieces. > > [24](/bible/daniel/7#v24) And the ten horns out of this kingdom are ten kings that shall arise: and another shall rise after them; and he shall be diverse from the first, and he shall subdue three kings. > > [25](/bible/daniel/7#v25) And he shall speak great words against the most High, and shall wear out the saints of the most High, and think to change times and laws: and they shall be given into his hand until a time and times and the dividing of time. > > [26](/bible/daniel/7#v26) But the judgment shall sit, and they shall take away his dominion, to consume and to destroy it unto the end. > > [27](/bible/daniel/7#v27) And the kingdom and dominion, and the greatness of the kingdom under the whole heaven, shall be given to the people of the saints of the most High, whose kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and all dominions shall serve and obey him. > > [28](/bible/daniel/7#v28) Hitherto is the end of the matter. As for me Daniel, my cogitations much troubled me, and my countenance changed in me: but I kept the matter in my heart. - I beheld till the thrones were cast down: every kingdom recorded in the chapter thrown down at Armageddon when Christ returns to destroy and set his people in rulership. The Ancient of Days did sit, in a garment white as snow, with hair like pure wool; he has a body, and it is not the Caucasian in your church. - The kingdom and dominion and the greatness of the kingdom under the whole heaven, the whole planet, shall be given to the people of the saints of the Most High. All the nations must bring the wealth back to Israel, including themselves; he will beautify the meek with salvation. - An everlasting kingdom, and all dominions shall serve and obey him; he goes out of Zion with a rod of iron and it will hurt. Hitherto is the end of the matter: God's whole plan is Israel ruling this planet indefinitely with every other dominion serving the Most High through her. Point blank, full stop. Precepts: - **[Daniel 2:44](/bible/daniel/2#v44)** > [44](/bible/daniel/2#v44) And in the days of these kings shall the God of heaven set up a kingdom, which shall never be destroyed: and the kingdom shall not be left to other people, but it shall break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms, and it shall stand for ever. In the days of these kings shall the God of heaven set up a kingdom which shall never be destroyed, nor left to other people; it shall break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms and stand for ever. The Most High is building this kingdom right now in the age of their decadence, and everybody will be made to follow this Bible, bend to the will of God, or die. - **[Hosea 1:10](/bible/hosea/1#v10)** > [10](/bible/hosea/1#v10) Yet the number of the children of Israel shall be as the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured nor numbered; and it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people, there it shall be said unto them, Ye are the sons of the living God. In the place where it was said unto them, ye are not my people, there it shall be said, ye are the sons of the living God. Where we were made dysfunctional and called coon and spear-chucker, everything except Israelites, the Lord will beautify the meek. The nations that put their hands on the apple of his eye will pay; he allows it and still makes them pay. - **[Romans 9:17-21](/bible/romans/9#v17)** > [17](/bible/romans/9#v17) For the scripture saith unto Pharaoh, Even for this same purpose have I raised thee up, that I might shew my power in thee, and that my name might be declared throughout all the earth. > > [18](/bible/romans/9#v18) Therefore hath he mercy on whom he will have mercy, and whom he will he hardeneth. > > [19](/bible/romans/9#v19) Thou wilt say then unto me, Why doth he yet find fault? For who hath resisted his will? > > [20](/bible/romans/9#v20) Nay but, O man, who art thou that repliest against God? Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it, Why hast thou made me thus? > > [21](/bible/romans/9#v21) Hath not the potter power over the clay, of the same lump to make one vessel unto honour, and another unto dishonour? For this same purpose have I raised thee up, that I might shew my power in thee. As with Pharaoh, so with Esau: God fattens him up with weapons, technology, and pride like a turkey before the holiday, hardens him so he cannot resist, and destroys him so his name is declared through all the earth. Who hath resisted his will? Pharaoh wanted to let Israel go and the Lord hardened his heart. Nay but, O man, who art thou that repliest against God? Esau was formed as the fitting vessel for God's destruction; one vessel is for wine and one for the bowels. You had better be glad you are the Israelites, because after slavery, Jim Crow, and lynchings, dying with the same man who did it is crazy. **[Isaiah 54:16-17](/bible/isaiah/54#v16)** *[[38:07](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lTjnCZsWsng&t=2287s)]* > [16](/bible/isaiah/54#v16) Behold, I have created the smith that bloweth the coals in the fire, and that bringeth forth an instrument for his work; and I have created the waster to destroy. > > [17](/bible/isaiah/54#v17) No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper; and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn. This is the heritage of the servants of the Lord, and their righteousness is of me, saith the Lord. - I have created the smith that bloweth the coals in the fire and bringeth forth an instrument for his work. The smith today is Lockheed Martin, Northrop Grumman, Oppenheimer, who did not want to build the bomb; the Lord made him build it and will make them press the button. The instrument is not a sword; it is a missile. - I have created the waster to destroy. That is a nuclear weapon the Lord himself called to be built. The weapon of their destruction is already here. - No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper, physical or psychological, and every tongue that rises against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn. Psalms 91 says only with thine eyes shalt thou behold the reward of the wicked: we will be taken up while the bombs destroy our enemies beneath us, if we dwell in the secret place, his commandments. - Shout out to Captain Joel's Art of War class, Deacon Eythan obliterating the Trinity again, and Deacon Malachiyah's Restoring the Broken Minds of the Daughters of Zion. Sisters sending hate mail against the prophets: judgments come quickly on people who open their mouths against the prophets of the Lord. **[2 Esdras 7:6-14](/bible/2-esdras/7#v6)** *[[52:47](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lTjnCZsWsng&t=3167s)]* > [6](/bible/2-esdras/7#v6) There is also another thing; A city is builded, and set upon a broad field, and is full of all good things: > > [7](/bible/2-esdras/7#v7) The entrance thereof is narrow, and is set in a dangerous place to fall, like as if there were a fire on the right hand, and on the left a deep water: > > [8](/bible/2-esdras/7#v8) And one only path between them both, even between the fire and the water, so small that there could but one man go there at once. > > [9](/bible/2-esdras/7#v9) If this city now were given unto a man for an inheritance, if he never shall pass the danger set before it, how shall he receive this inheritance? > > [10](/bible/2-esdras/7#v10) And I said, It is so, Lord. Then said he unto me, Even so also is Israel’s portion. > > [11](/bible/2-esdras/7#v11) Because for their sakes I made the world: and when Adam transgressed my statutes, then was decreed that now is done. > > [12](/bible/2-esdras/7#v12) Then were the entrances of this world made narrow, full of sorrow and travail: they are but few and evil, full of perils,: and very painful. > > [13](/bible/2-esdras/7#v13) For the entrances of the elder world were wide and sure, and brought immortal fruit. > > [14](/bible/2-esdras/7#v14) If then they that live labour not to enter these strait and vain things, they can never receive those that are laid up for them. - A city built on a broad field full of all good things, the kingdom, with a narrow entrance set in a dangerous place, fire on the right and deep water on the left. The temptations and afflictions of our enemies are the fire and water; without them the journey would be smooth, but God set it that way because we messed up and must serve them. - Only one path between them, so small that but one man may go at once; if he never passes the danger, how shall he receive the inheritance? All the psychological traps and vicious evils we endure are the Most High trying us. - Even so also is Israel's portion, because for their sakes I made the world, and when Adam transgressed my statutes the decree was made. Adam and Eve were our forefather and foremother; the labour pains Deacon Abbayael taught on and the psychological sorrows, the gangs, the children snuffed out, are all the entrances made narrow, full of sorrow and travail, few and evil, full of perils and very painful. - The entrances of the elder world were wide and brought immortal fruit; that was before we messed up. If they that live labour not to enter these strait and vain things, they can never receive what is laid up for them. The Most High does not want you to give up; he wants you to endure and fix it. - On postpartum: Deacon Malachiyah took hate for saying much of it is emotion, and the Bishop will take some too. Bearing children is the woman's makeup; the problem is a society with no support, sisters hating sisters, brothers hating women, a father barred from the maternity floor or fighting another man there, while the Edomite family fills the waiting room with jubilee. It is our job as men to build the midwives and the network so a sister brings forth fruit in a good way. Do not blame the children; a righteous child is a gift. Precepts: - **[Judges 3:1-2](/bible/judges/3#v1)** > [1](/bible/judges/3#v1) Now these are the nations which the Lord left, to prove Israel by them, even as many of Israel as had not known all the wars of Canaan; > > [2](/bible/judges/3#v2) Only that the generations of the children of Israel might know, to teach them war, at the least such as before knew nothing thereof; These are the nations which the Lord left to prove Israel, that the generations might know to teach them war, at least such as before knew nothing thereof. He did not remove all the nations because he did not want us to skate through. We are in training now; in the kingdom we will be experts in everything. They can kill the body but not the spirit, and when I come back I am hanging you. **[Jeremiah 1:4-5](/bible/jeremiah/1#v4)** *[[1:08:46](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lTjnCZsWsng&t=4126s)]* > [4](/bible/jeremiah/1#v4) Then the word of the Lord came unto me, saying, > > [5](/bible/jeremiah/1#v5) Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee, and I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations. - Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee, and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee. Your spirit was not a mistake; among millions of sperm the Lord chose which spirit to send, you rather than another, for a purpose. You were already known before the sperm hit the egg. - I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations. Whatever the Lord ordained us to be, we will be, and he put talents in us. That is why the Bishop stresses organizing those talents; you cannot bring self-doubt around him. Get the doubt out and let the real you stay and be built up. Precepts: - **[Romans 7:15](/bible/romans/7#v15)** > [15](/bible/romans/7#v15) For that which I do I allow not: for what I would, that do I not; but what I hate, that do I. That which I do I allow not; for what I would, that do I not; but what I hate, that do I. The real spirit connected to God hates evil, and the conditioned self does it anyway. That duality is the daily fight. Christ said deny yourself: the you doing the denying is what God is dealing with, and the self is the composite of conditioning. Examine your behaviour and ask whether it is the real you or a response to conditioning. - **[Genesis 1:27-28](/bible/genesis/1#v27)** > [27](/bible/genesis/1#v27) So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them. > > [28](/bible/genesis/1#v28) And God blessed them, and God said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it: and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth. God created man in his own image, blessed them, and said be fruitful and multiply and have dominion. This is the original declaration about you specifically, the real soul of man and woman, not the whore, drug addict, or dealer they told you that you are. You were made in the image of God, not in the image of your dysfunction, your traumatic experiences, an unstable childhood, an abusive relationship, or an environment that never reflected your worth. Before conditioning, survival strategies, and the false self, there was an image, and it carries creativity, dominion, and fruitfulness as original attributes in your DNA. Regardless of what you went through, you can fix it; IUIC told everybody who said we could not to go to hell. - **[Exodus 11:7](/bible/exodus/11#v7)** > [7](/bible/exodus/11#v7) But against any of the children of Israel shall not a dog move his tongue, against man or beast: that ye may know how that the Lord doth put a difference between the Egyptians and Israel. Against any of the children of Israel shall not a dog move his tongue, against man or beast, that ye may know the Lord doth put a difference between the Egyptians and Israel. Not even a dog may speak against you. You are the jewellery God wears around his neck, the apple of his eye; carry yourself like that even in captivity, because it is temporary. They say you do not talk like a slave because I am not one. Christ on the cross knew he could call down legions, and we are joint heirs; the world is terrified of us making that connection. - **[Isaiah 43:21](/bible/isaiah/43#v21)** > [21](/bible/isaiah/43#v21) This people have I formed for myself; they shall shew forth my praise.
